youtube.title: Columbia: The Engineers Who Asked to Look at the Wing
youtube.description:
82 seconds after launch, foam struck Columbia's left wing. Engineers asked at least three times for images of the damage; the request was cancelled. One engineer drafted an email calling it 'the wrong (and bordering on irresponsible) answer', and never sent it. Sixteen minutes before landing, Columbia broke apart over Texas. This is the full file: the request, the unsent email, and the test that finally showed what had been hiding on the wing.
